in_hebrew.name: Myrvyn
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Protector of secrets
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Myrvyn הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old Welsh name Myrddin, meaning 'sea god' or 'sea chief'. Myrvyn may be interpreted as 'protector of secrets' due to its Welsh origins and association with the mystical sea god.

Myrvyn may be interpreted as 'protector of secrets' due to its Welsh origins and association with the mystical sea god.

in_latin.name: Myrvyn
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Protector of secrets
